# This PR opened in 2018 


## UPDATE 2025

Hi everyone,

I’d like to sincerely apologise for this pull request.
Looking back, I realise it was completely unnecessary and not an appropriate way to engage with the Linux kernel project.

At the time (2018), I was still learning how GitHub works and how contributions to large projects like the kernel are supposed to be made. My intent wasn’t to waste anyone’s time or cause a distraction, but I now understand that even small, non-functional changes can create noise and take attention away from important work.

To all the contributors (listed below) and especially @torvalds, I apologize for any inconvenience or disruption this may have caused. I appreciate the work you all do and have a much greater respect for the proper contribution process now.

Thank you for your understanding,

BR,
Orhan

title: Make the kernel cute
body: The demographic for Linux has a higher than average enjoyment of cuteness, especially with regards to anime. This PR will make the Linux kernel more comfortable and easier to maintain and use for people like me who enjoy cute things.
